verdict.rationale: Reflect's own docs state that note contents are end-to-end encrypted and that "no one else can read them (not even us)". The API docs confirm the servers can't read note contents. Its hosted service backs both an iOS app and browser extensions, which implies cross-device sync, and the community credits Reflect with a security audit. However, uploaded files and images are not end-to-end encrypted, per a community-quoted vendor statement, and no doc describes the sync mechanism itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device sync behavior and the platforms it covers, E2EE coverage of attachments and files, and independent hands-on verification of the encryption.
